context: Mei and Aoi chat about an awkward payday.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (給料/迷惑/具合/落とし/身近) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日、給料が入ったんだ!
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、おめでとう。具合はどう?
lines.en: Nice, congrats. How are you feeling?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 実は、財布を落としちゃって。
lines.style: sheepish barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、それは迷惑な話だね。
lines.style: concerned woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 落とした場所が、身近な公園でね。
lines.en: I dropped it at a familiar park.
lines.style: relieved barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 身近な人が、届けてくれたの?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、迷惑かけたけど、戻ってきたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I caused trouble, but it came back.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 良かった!給料、大事に使ってね。
lines.style: warm woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
